title: IonQ Stock Rises 12.6% as Quantum Stocks Rebound (Nov 23)
summary: IonQ (IONQ) closed at $23.34 on Nov 23, up 12.64%, as quantum stocks rebounded after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.
body_markdown:
## Why IonQ Stock Rose


The trigger came from outside IonQ. According to[Nvidia's official release](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-board-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-president-ceo-and-board-director) dated November 23, its board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang as president, CEO and board director, effective immediately, with Colette Kress continuing as chief financial officer after serving as interim CEO. "I am honored to return to NVIDIA," Huang said in the release.


As reported by[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/rigetti-surges-17-jensen-huang-170404274.html) , traders read the Nvidia news as a green light for the wider advanced-computing trade, and the quantum group moved together, with Rigetti Computing and D-Wave Quantum also posting double-digit gains. The outlet noted that Nvidia's CUDA-Q software links its AI ecosystem to quantum developers, and that IonQ lists Nvidia among its enterprise partners.


According to[The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-ionq-stock-gaining-today-182502483.html) , quantum stocks were recovering part of the previous week's losses amid the tech rally, and[Huang's return](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-stock-trump-urges-board-rehire-jensen-huang/) came less than two weeks after he resigned. The outlet added that IonQ announced plans in September to install one of its quantum computers at Nvidia's research center, a tie it described as a research partnership rather than a commercial one. Neither outlet cited an announcement from IonQ itself on Monday.


## IONQ Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- According to[IonQ's third-quarter release](https://ionq.com/news/ionq-announces-record-3q26-revenues-and-raises-fy2026-guidance-to-505---515-million-as-backlog-grows-to-1-2-billion) of November 5, revenue rose 336% from a year earlier to $173.8 million, and the company raised its 2026 revenue guidance to between $505 million and $515 million.
- The company said its remaining performance obligations more than doubled to $1.2 billion, and that cash, cash equivalents and investments stood at $1.7 billion on September 30, or $3.7 billion pro forma for a $2.0 billion equity offering that closed on October 16.
- In its bull case for the group, 24/7 Wall St. cited CHIPS Act funding and the chance that Huang's return keeps Nvidia's quantum software push on track.


### Risks


- IonQ is still losing money on an adjusted basis: its release showed an adjusted EBITDA loss of $133.6 million for the third quarter.
- 24/7 Wall St. reported that dilution worries tied to IonQ's $2 billion stock sale weighed on sentiment across the quantum group heading into Monday's bounce.
- The outlet described the quantum names as[high-beta stocks](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/beta-meaning/) that swing harder than the overall market, and named widening losses and lumpy revenue across the sector as its bear case.
